label: Tuesday, October 27, 2026 · AI-IPO rally, day two edition
intro: Five finance reads to open the day. Headlines and two-sentence takes stay here; the full articles stay with the publishers. USC students read almost all of these free through the USC Libraries.

items.title: Stock Market News for Oct 27, 2026: Anthropic files S-1 for Nasdaq listing under ticker 'ANT'
items.take: Anthropic filed its S-1 for a Nasdaq listing under ticker ANT, disclosing first-half 2026 revenues of $16.29 billion, up more than 1,300% from a year earlier. The filing revived the AI trade Monday, and Bloomberg says it could raise more money in its IPO than any firm in history.

items.title: Stock market today: S&P 500, Nasdaq lead stocks higher as tech bounces back
items.take: The Fed opens its two-day October meeting today, with economists expecting a so-called 'hawkish pause' when it decides Wednesday. Markets price only about a 10% chance the central bank actually hikes, per CME Group.

items.title: Stock Market Today: Dow, S&P Live Updates for October 27
items.take: Monday's Anthropic-driven rally cooled a little Tuesday, with futures stalling as traders turn to a busy earnings slate, the Fed decision and simmering Middle East tensions. Oil slipped for a second day on hopes stepped-up US-Iran diplomacy averts an escalation.

items.title: DoorDash in talks to buy Instacart in roughly $17 billion deal, source says
items.take: DoorDash is in advanced talks to buy Instacart for roughly $17 billion, and a source tells Reuters a deal could be finalized as soon as Wednesday. Instacart jumped 8% Monday while DoorDash fell about 6%; Instacart's earlier talks with Uber are no longer active.

items.title: Coca-Cola raises outlook; UPS lifts full-year guidance as earnings roll in
items.take: Coca-Cola beat and raised its outlook even as it flagged slowing North American demand, while UPS rose 2% after lifting its full-year guidance. Alphabet and Microsoft report their quarters on Wednesday.

items.title: Morgan Stanley · Thoughts on the Market — The Next Stage of the Market Correction
items.take: Monday's episode asks where this pullback sits in the cycle and what would extend or end it. Short and sharp, perfect between classes.
